maddeler.e:
نستلب (form VIII)
# نَسْتَلِبُ (nastalibu) /nas.ta.li.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
# نُسْتَلَبُ (nustalabu) /nus.ta.la.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
# نَسْتَلِبَ (nastaliba) /nas.ta.li.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
# نُسْتَلَبَ (nustalaba) /nus.ta.la.ba/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
